scope: Control-network behavioral ngspice + independent resistor equations; not converter/complete UPS qualification
reference_source: TI TLV431B SLVS139Z Table5.7 BI full-temperature; LM393LV SNOSDA4D electrical characteristics +/-3mV full-temperature

ntc.assumptions: 10k B3950 NTC, R25/B +/-1%, resistors +/-1%, TP4056 TEMP ratios ideal0.45/0.80; IC temperature ratio tolerance not modeled
ntc.validation_needed: Select actual pack NTC; measure trip temperatures and charging termination with backup idle load.

reservoir.limitation: TPS2117 16us is typical under specified load; not worst-case proof. Comparator/RC delay, converter response and ESR must be measured.
